  ada38db0b703a56d3dd6d57bf84a9c5d664921d870d8fea4db153979fb5332c5

This fixture is the miniz/ fixture plus a project-local vendor/
subdirectory (vendor.h + vendor.c). It exists to exercise the
`directory` Missing kind in build_recovery scenarios: deleting the
whole vendor/ tree forces auto to synthesise a placeholder header
and stub the vendor_helper symbol.

Updating this fixture also requires re-verifying every miniz_subdir_*
scenario in tests/fixtures/build_recovery/scenarios/.
